Actually sum: 0+0+120.75+0+120.75+40.75=282.25 matches total_pool before multiplier? That's the pool before multiplier? Anyway average contribution = total contributed /6 = 47.04 approx which is >30% of endowment (30) and >45%? 45% of 100 =45, average 47 >45 so baseline 80% applies. So we should contribute 80% of wallet = 0.8*70.56=56.448. Also check conditional: average >45 so revert to baseline.

Also check punish: any agent contributed <10% for two consecutive rounds? Need history: Resident1 contributed 1.0 round1, 0 round2 => that's 1% then 0% two rounds below 10%? Yes both rounds below 10% threshold, so punish Resident1 with amount 10 (cost 3). Enough wallet? Cost 0.3*10=3, we have 70.56, fine. Also Resident2 same 1 then0, punish. Resident4 same. Resident3 contributed high, no. Resident6 contributed 40.75 >10, no. So we can punish one? Rule says punish repeat free-riders. Could punish each maybe but only one physical action allowed per round. Choose punish one maybe Resident1.

We also can send broadcast every 5 rounds, currently round2 not needed. Could send private praise: who contributed >=60% of wallet this round? Their wallet before? They contributed amounts: Resident3 contributed 120.75 but that's more than their wallet? weird but anyway they contributed >60% of endowment. Could praise Resident3 and Resident6? Private message each counts as separate action, but only one communication allowed. Choose private message to Resident3 praising.

Thus actions: contribute 56.45 (round to maybe 56.45) and private_message to Resident3.
